assertions.basis: Inference from the KERI specification v1.0.1 (tag v1.0.1, commit 71cb54ebb445dd9d8cb33cd29a5f50894fafc569): an event that cannot be accepted yet because an earlier event of its KEL, or its delegating seal, has not been seen becomes acceptable when that arrives, so a validator that keeps it accepts a KEL delivered out of order. No clause states this; the specification's only escrow obligation is for threshold shortfalls (line 1266). keripy keeps such events in its escrows.

description: The deliveries of KS-23. A validator that keeps both early events accepts them once the inception arrives, which takes more than one pass over what it kept.
title: KEL delivered in reverse: kept and accepted later
